source: Scryfall Tagger oracle-tags bulk export, retrieved 2026-09-24
note: Taggings stripped; re-download the bulk file for card mappings

tags.label: activated ability
tags.description: Cards with activated abilities.

tags.label: spot removal
tags.description: Removal for one target specifically.  See also [sweeper](sweeper) and [multi removal](multi-removal).

tags.label: evasion
tags.description: Creatures that are harder to block through keywords (flying, menace) or other means.

tags.label: single target instant/sorcery
tags.description: Instant/sorcery spells that may target only one target. This is materially important for some effects that care about single targets. Not mutually exclusive with [multiple targets](/tags/card/multiple-targets).

tags.label: alliteration
tags.description: Cards that alliterate, either properly or per Treacherous Trapezist.

tags.label: repeatable crime
tags.description: Repeatable ways to commit crimes by targeting an opponent or something they control.

tags.label: unique type line
tags.description: No other card has this same type line. Acorn, playtest, and rebalanced cards may count as unique, but they don't make non-acorn, non-playtest, non-rebalanced cards stop counting as unique.

tags.label: intervening if clause
tags.description: At/When/Whenever [event], if [clause], [effect].

tags.label: repeatable pp counters
tags.description: Repeatable ways of putting +1/+1 counters on creatures.

tags.label: noncreature typal
tags.description: Cards that care about creature types, but not necessarily on a creature card—so they're compatible with the Kindred cards from Lorwyn, for example.

tags.label: namesake spell
tags.description: Spells (or, mostly spells) with names that identify them with a specific named character.

tags.label: attacking matters-self
tags.description: Cards that care about themselves attacking. See also [attacking matters](attacking-matters) for cards that care about attacking in general.

tags.label: virtual vanilla
tags.description: These creatures are effectively just vanilla after entering the battlefield. They may have an enters-the-battlefield or on-cast trigger.

tags.label: draw engine
tags.description: Card draw effects that can net you additional cards repeatedly over time. Contrast [Burst Draw](burst-draw), which nets you multiple cards right away.

tags.label: french vanilla
tags.description: These creatures, vehicles and spacecraft have only keyword abilities.

tags.label: multiple targets
tags.description: These cards can target more than one object or player. Not mutually exclusive with [single target instant/sorcery](/tags/card/single-target-instant-sorcery).

tags.label: repeatable creature tokens
tags.description: Repeatable ways to create creature tokens

tags.label: repeatable pure draw
tags.description: Repeatable ways to draw a card with no additional cost or sacrifice, such as discarding a card

tags.label: cheaper than mv
tags.description: The actual cost you pay for an effect (or for an alternate mode) will often be lower than the card's mana value.

tags.label: gives pp counters
tags.description: Cards that give +1/+1 counters. For permanents that only give +1/+1 counters to themselves, see [gains pp counters](gains-pp-counters).

tags.label: drawback
tags.description: Cards that have some kind of disadvantage.

tags.label: virtual french vanilla
tags.description: Creatures and vehicles that are french vanilla (having only keyword abilities) after entering the battlefield. They may have "enters the battlefield" or "on cast" trigger.

tags.label: alternative cost
tags.description: Spells with alternative casting costs, which may be cheaper or more expensive than their mana costs. See CR 118.9.

tags.label: cast trigger-you
tags.description: Whenever you cast X, do something.

tags.label: single english word name
tags.description: Cards named with a single word in English. This may be a compound word.

tags.label: pure draw
tags.description: Spells and abilities that let you draw (a) card(s) without discarding other cards or sacrificing other permanents.

tags.label: attacking matters
tags.description: Cards that care about attacking. See also [attacking matters-self](attacking-matters-self) for cards that care about themselves attacking.

tags.label: delayed trigger
tags.description: Create a triggered ability that may trigger later. Similar to a [reflexive trigger](reflexive-trigger).

tags.label: combat trick
tags.description: Effects that can be used during combat to help a creature survive, destroy opposing creatures, or deal additional combat damage.

tags.label: mana sink
tags.description: Cards with repeatable effects that you can dump a bunch of mana (at least 3) into each turn.

tags.label: more expensive than mv
tags.description: The actual cost you pay for an effect (or for an alternate mode) will often be higher than the card's mana value. See also [cards with X in their mana cost](https://scryfall.com/search?q=m%3Ax).

tags.label: power boost to all
tags.description: Cards that provide power to all creatures you control. May be limited to certain types or colors.

tags.label: burn any
tags.description: Cards that burn any target: players, creatures, battles, or planeswalkers.

tags.label: lifegain
tags.description: Cards that cause you to gain life.

tags.label: exile-self
tags.description: Cards which exile themselves (from the battlefield, from the graveyard, from your hand, etc.)

tags.label: additional cost
tags.description: Spells with additional costs. See CR 118.8.

tags.label: bottomless mana sink
tags.description: Repeatable effects that, if an arbitrary amount of mana is dumped into them, will probably win you the game—for example, by drawing your whole deck, creating an arbitrarily large attacker, making an endless army of tokens, gaining infinite life, etc.

tags.label: symmetrical
tags.description: Cards that affect the whole battlefield/all players in symmetrical, equal manner.

tags.label: protects-creature
tags.description: Effects that can protect a creature, e.g. with protection,  hexproof, indestructible, etc.

tags.label: pinger
tags.description: Effects that deal just 1-2 damage repeatedly.

tags.label: group slug
tags.description: Cards that are able to deal damage or otherwise target multiple players at once.

tags.label: sweeper
tags.description: _o\ Destroy all the things! See also [spot removal](spot-removal) and [multi removal](multi-removal).

tags.label: death trigger-self
tags.description: Permanents with abilities that trigger when they die.

tags.label: cantrip
tags.description: Cards that let you draw a card as they resolve or enter the battlefield.

tags.label: multi removal
tags.description: Removal for more than one, but less than all.  See also [spot removal](spot-removal) and [sweeper](sweeper).

tags.label: burst draw
tags.description: Card draw effects that can net you a bunch of cards at once. As a rule of thumb, to qualify for this tag, the card should let you draw at least three cards at a time and come out ahead by at least +1.

tags.label: removal-toughness
tags.description: Removal that can kill creatures by reducing their toughness to 0 or less.

tags.label: repeatable sacrifice outlet
tags.description: Repeatedly sacrifice stuff.

tags.label: death trigger
tags.description: Abilities that trigger from permanents being sent to a graveyard. See also [leaves trigger](leaves-battlefield-trigger).

tags.label: modal
tags.description: Spells which give you your choice from two or more distinct functions.

tags.label: anthem
tags.description: Your entire team gets +N/+N. Possibly limited to creature types or colors.

tags.label: tutor-to-hand
tags.description: Cards that tutor cards to the player's hand.

tags.label: type addition human
tags.description:
Creatures that weren't previously a human and just identified by their job, despite being a human, and then gained that type.

Creatures that had a strange type line from before standardisation, then jumped straight to being human aren't counted in this

tags.label: discard
tags.description: Gets cards out of your opponent's hand and into their graveyard.

tags.label: reanimate-creature
tags.description: Return creature cards currently in the graveyard to the battlefield. Not to be confused with [cheat death](/tags/card/cheat-death), which interacts right as the creature dies.

tags.label: ramp
tags.description: Effects that increase available mana for current or later turns.

tags.label: creaturefall
tags.description: Cards that care about a creature entering the battlefield. Also known as Alliance in New Capenna.

tags.label: martyr
tags.description: Creatures that sacrifice themselves for benefit.

tags.label: activate from hand
tags.description: Activated abilities that can be activated from your hand.

tags.label: saboteur
tags.description: Effects that trigger when you deal damage to an opponent.

tags.label: adds multiple mana
tags.description: Cards that net you more than one mana at a time.

tags.label: potentially black border
tags.description: Cards not intended for constructed play that could have been printed in a vintage/commander legal product instead if they were printed today.

tags.label: keyword anthem
tags.description: Give your entire team a keyword.

tags.label: out of color token
tags.description: Cards which create tokens which are one or more colours the original card isn't.

tags.label: punny name
tags.description: Names that are puns or otherwise a play on words

tags.label: enters in company
tags.description: Creatures that come with more creatures attached on ETB without reanimating them.

tags.label: type errata
tags.description: Cards that were printed with a type-line that has since been updated. For cards whose token generation has changed, see [Token Errata](token-errata).

tags.label: discard outlet
tags.description: Ways to discard your own cards.

tags.label: land ramp
tags.description: Ramp spells that net you more lands on your side of the battlefield.

tags.label: mana dork
tags.description: Creatures which can repeatedly generate mana

tags.label: per-player
tags.description: Effects that scale positively with the number of players; i. e., "for each player", "for each opponent", etc.

tags.label: castable from exile
tags.description: Cards you can cast or access from exile.

tags.label: free-cast-another
tags.description: Cast other things without paying their mana cost.

tags.label: multiple bodies
tags.description: One-shot effects that put two or more creatures onto the battlefield on resolution.

tags.label: block trigger
tags.description: Effects that trigger on a creature blocking or becoming blocked.

tags.label: castable from graveyard
tags.description: Cards you can cast or access from the graveyard.

tags.label: scales with power
tags.description: Effects which scale with the power of one or more creatures.

tags.label: cast on resolution
tags.description: Spells and abilities that let you cast spells as part of their resolution.

tags.label: drain life
tags.description: Hurt your opponent and gain life to match.

tags.label: gives castable from exile
tags.description: Cards that let you cast things from exile.

tags.label: unique token
tags.description: This token is created by only one card.

tags.label: fun ruling
tags.description: Cards with rulings where the rules manager is having fun with us. Not necessarily laugh-out-loud funny.

tags.label: self-replacement effect
tags.description: A resolving spell or ability partially or completely replacing one of its own effects.

tags.label: sacrifice self
tags.description: Permanents that have abilities that make them sacrifice themselves.

tags.label: tutor-land-basic
tags.description: Cards that tutor basic land cards.

tags.label: mini refund
tags.description: Immediately gives you a small amount of mana or untapped lands back (typically no more than about one-third of the mana cost you paid)

tags.label: repeatable card advantage
tags.description: Things that give you access to more cards, repeatably.

tags.label: life payment
tags.description: Cards that cost life to use; not necessarily with the "pay" keyword.

tags.label: mill-self
tags.description: Cards that put cards from top of your own library to the graveyard. Check the tag "mill" for more.

tags.label: regrowth-creature
tags.description: Return a creature from the graveyard to the hand

tags.label: offcolor ability
tags.description: Abilities with a mana cost outside the card's colors.

tags.label: egg
tags.description: Artifacts that have to be sacrificed to do something.

tags.label: untracked indefinite effect
tags.description: Effects that last forever but aren't tracked by anything. For these purposes we're not counting ETB clones.

tags.label: force draw
tags.description: Force an opponent to draw cards, whether they like it or not. The lesser used mode on Ancestral Recall.

tags.label: unique mana cost
tags.description: This card's mana cost isn't found on any other card.

tags.label: tap fuel-creature
tags.description: Tap a creature to pay for/activate an effect

tags.label: reflexive trigger
tags.description: An ability that triggers based on actions taken earlier during a spell or ability's resolution.

tags.label: enlarge
tags.description: Effects that give a creature +N/+M. These values should be significant—usually at least +3/+3 or better, roundabouts.

tags.label: copy-self
tags.description: Cards that make a copy of themselves

tags.label: aesthetic counter
tags.description: Counters that have no rules meaning, just aesthetic.

tags.label: digital-only mechanics
tags.description: Cards with mechanics designed for the digital environment of Magic Arena. Includes Unknown and acorn cards with mechanics equivalent to an existing Arena one.

tags.label: bear with set's mechanic
tags.description: A 2/2 for 2 with one of the set's iconic mechanics

tags.label: shade pump
tags.description: Effects that give an arbitrary amount of +1/+1 until end of turn. See also [firebreathing](firebeathing) in red and [armoring](armoring) in white.

tags.label: life for cards
tags.description: Get cards in exchange for your life (damage causes loss of life).

tags.label: firebreathing
tags.description: Give a creature +X/+0 until end of turn via an activated ability.

tags.label: protects-all
tags.description: Effects that give a form of protection to all permanents of a kind. (That may be hexproof, indestructible, protection, etc.)

tags.label: gives vigilance
tags.description: See also [untapper-creature](untapper-creature).

tags.label: scry
tags.description: See also [scry-like](scry-like) for effects that are like scry, but don't use the keyword.

tags.label: refund
tags.description: Immediately get mana or untapped lands back.

tags.label: burn with set's mechanic
tags.description: Burn spells that have the mechanic of the set they debuted in.

tags.label: reanimate-self
tags.description: These cards can return themselves to the battlefield if they're sitting in the graveyard. Not to be confused with [cheat death-self](cheat-death-self), where the card returns immediately after dying.

tags.label: hate-set-mechanic
tags.description: Cards that "hate" on one or more mechanics in the set they were printed in.

tags.label: rhystic
tags.description: Effects that opponents can buy off if they pay mana.

tags.label: shapechange
tags.description: Set creatures' power/toughness, not necessarily a nerf. See also [humble](/tags/card/humble).

tags.label: curiosity
tags.description: Draw cards when dealing damage to an opponent

tags.label: cast trigger-self
tags.description: Cards that have a trigger when they are cast

tags.label: cda-power
tags.description: Creatures that have their power determined by a characteristic-defining ability.

tags.label: utility mana rock
tags.description: Mana rocks that do extra things.

tags.label: unnoted tracked information
tags.description: Spells or abilities that require tracking events without explicitly noting them. See also [noted tracked information](noted-tracked-information).

tags.label: pair-commander
tags.description: These cards can be one half of a two-card pair of commanders

tags.label: sweeper-one-sided
tags.description: Sweepers that are, or have high potential to be, one-sided.

tags.label: landfall
tags.description: Cards which reward you for playing lands.

tags.label: upkeep cost
tags.description: Cards that ask you to pay some kind of cost on your upkeep step.

tags.label: low mana value matters
tags.description: Effects that care about your things with mana value below some boundary value, usually 2 to 4.

tags.label: type addition phyrexian
tags.description: Gained the Phyrexian type, either after it was introduced with the big sweep at Modern Horizons 2 launch, or at a later date.

tags.label: creates bigger body
tags.description: Creature cards that generate additional creatures beefier than themselves. (Typically this means having a higher total power and toughness than the original creature.)

tags.label: cards in graveyard matter
tags.description: Mechanics that care about the cards in one or more graveyards.

tags.label: surveil
tags.description: Cards that let you look at the top # cards of your library and put some into the graveyard.

tags.label: jump
tags.description: A creature gains flying until end of turn.

tags.label: selective group hug
tags.description: Group Hug cards that benefit only certain opponents in particular.

tags.label: virtual legendary
tags.description: This card represents a one-of-a-kind creature or object (and is named accordingly), and could conceivably have been legendary. Usually cards are in this category because they were printed before legendary existed or have a mechanical need to not be legendary.

tags.label: discount-self
tags.description: Cards that have a way to reduce their own cost

tags.label: dnd character
tags.description: Cards that represent Dungeons and Dragons characters: name, rules text, etc. See also the [dungeons and dragons](/tags/artwork/dungeons-and-dragons) art tag.

tags.label: gives pp counters to all
tags.description: Put +1/+1 counters on all of your creatures.

tags.label: manaless value
tags.description: Cards that can provide some amount of value without untapped lands.

tags.label: deprecated legend type
tags.description: These cards were originally printed with the Legend creature type. Their type line read “Summon Legend” or “Creature — Legend”.

tags.label: name matters
tags.description: Effects that care about card names: different names, same name, specific name, etc.

tags.label: non mana ability mana
tags.description: Abilities that produce mana, but aren't mana abilities (as defined by CR 605.1)

tags.label: regrowth-self
tags.description: Cards that can return themselves from the graveyard to the hand.

tags.label: crew
tags.description: Compilation tag for the Crew keyword. Should be 1:1 with [kw:crew](https://scryfall.com/search?q=kw%3Acrew).

tags.label: restricted mana
tags.description: Mana that has restrictions on what you can or cannot use it on.

tags.label: activate from graveyard
tags.description: Abilities that can be activated from inside a graveyard.

tags.label: toll
tags.description: Generate resources from your opponent's actions without them being able to pay it off.

tags.label: free sacrifice outlet
tags.description: Ways to sacrifice a permanent repeatedly that require no additional cost.

tags.label: freeze-creature
tags.description: Prevent a creature from untapping for its next N untaps. For effects that prevent untapping indefinitely, see [lockdown](lockdown-creature).

tags.label: mill-any
tags.description: Cards that let you choose a library to mill. Could be yours, could be theirs. It could also be an indirect choice, e.g. milling the controller of a targeted permanent.

tags.label: cda-toughness
tags.description: Creatures whose toughness is determined via a characteristic-defining ability.

tags.label: group hug
tags.description: Cards that can be used to benefit other players, including opponents, usually by giving them resources

tags.label: donate token
tags.description: Effects that can create tokens under an opponents control.

tags.label: gives mm counters
tags.description: Cards that give -1/-1 counters.

tags.label: repeatable scry
tags.description: See also: [repeatable surveil](repeatable-surveil).

tags.label: graveyard fuel
tags.description: Cards that require exiling other cards in graveyard as a cost for abilities and effects.

tags.label: paper-compatible
tags.description: Online-only cards that would work if printed in paper, albeit annoying to track or execute at times

tags.label: graveyard fuel-creature
tags.description: Exiles creatures from the graveyard for value

tags.label: typal coupling
tags.description: Cards that care about two or more different creature types.

tags.label: disenchant/naturalize
tags.description: Cards that remove artifacts and/or enchantments.

tags.label: tutor-to-battlefield
tags.description: Cards that tutor something out of the library and straight onto the battlefield.

tags.label: regenerates self
tags.description: Cards with effects that regenerate themselves.

tags.label: aikido
tags.description: Effects that turn your opponent's strength against them.

tags.label: titan trigger
tags.description: An ability that triggers on both entering the battlefield and attacking, similar to the Titan cycle from M11

tags.label: one-sided fight
tags.description: A creature deals damage equal to its power to another. Like Fight, but without the chance to fight back. See also [fling](/tags/card/fling) which involves sacrificing the creature.

tags.label: land count matters
tags.description: Specifically your land count, not [your opponent's](opponent-land-count-matters).

tags.label: giant growth
tags.description: Combat tricks that give a creature +N/+N. See also [Enlarge](enlarge).

tags.label: ward
tags.description: Collection tag for the Ward keyword. Should be 1:1 with kw:ward.

tags.label: hate-high-pt
tags.description: Cards that specifically hate on cards with high power or toughness, typically at least 3-4.

tags.label: multi land ramp
tags.description: Land ramp that (potentially) nets two or more lands on your side of the battlefield

tags.label: vanity card
tags.description: Cards named after specific people or real things

tags.label: renew
tags.description: Exile this card from your graveyard: Do a thing. Doesn't need to be the specific Renew keyword, just cards that have an ability to exile themselves in the graveyard.

tags.label: type addition from none
tags.description: Some creatures (Commonly artifact creatures) prior to the Grand Creature Type update were printed without Creature Types.

tags.label: leaves trigger-self
tags.description: Permanents with abilities that trigger when they leave the battlefield.

tags.label: combat ramp
tags.description: Generate mana/more lands by attacking and/or dealing combat damage

tags.label: mix-and-match
tags.description: Two or more non-evergreen mechanics blended together on the same card.

tags.label: tome
tags.description: Providing incremental card advantage over time (usually by tapping to draw cards, although there are variants that [tutor](tutor), [impulsive draw](impulsive-draw), etc.) has been a staple effect for noncreature artifacts since the printing of Jayemdae Tome in Alpha.

tags.label: color break
tags.description: Cards known to break the modern color pie, granting a color access to something it shouldn't be able to do.

tags.label: rhyming name
tags.description: Cards whose names contain a rhyme, or come very close to it.

tags.label: thoughtseize
tags.description: Opponent reveals their hand, and you choose a card for them to discard.

tags.label: faux targeting
tags.description: Things that have to choose "targets", but don't actually *target*, meaning this bypasses keywords such as hexproof, protection, and shroud.

tags.label: copy-spell
tags.description: Make a copy of a spell on the stack.

tags.label: uninspired
tags.description: Effects that trigger when something becomes tapped. For cards that care about tapped permanents, see [synergy-tapped](synergy-tapped) and [tapped matters-self](tapped-matters-self).

tags.label: reanimate-cast
tags.description: Cast a permanent spell from a graveyard.

tags.label: unique counter
tags.description: These cards use a type of counter no other card does.

tags.label: trigger from graveyard
tags.description: Abilities that trigger from inside the graveyard.

tags.label: portmanteau
tags.description: Cards named with a portmanteau—a word that's a combination of two words.

tags.label: ditch hand
tags.description: Cards that let you get rid of your current hand in some way or other.

tags.label: multiplayer
tags.description: Cards that interact with all of the players in the game. They might scale with the number of players or affect the turn order for example.

tags.label: burn-you
tags.description: Sometimes your own cards hurt you the most.

tags.label: toughness matters
tags.description: Other than in, you know, the usual way.

tags.label: humble
tags.description: Nerf a creature's stats and/or abilities as a form of removal. See also [shapechange](/tags/card/shapechange), [swap removal](swap-removal) and [deanimate](deanimate).

tags.label: unprinted token
tags.description: Cards whose tokens haven't yet been printed in paper.

tags.label: punisher
tags.description: Effects that give you a choice of two damnations.

tags.label: hate-discard
tags.description: Your opponent had better think twice before targeting you with that [Mind Rot](https://tagger.scryfall.com/card/ori/281)!

tags.label: counterspell-soft
tags.description: A "soft counterspell" gives the other player a chance to buy off the counter, such as with a mana payment.

tags.label: heroic
tags.description: Whenever you cast a spell targeting your permanent, something good happens.

tags.label: real life animal name
tags.description: Card names that match real world english animal names. "Manta ray" is accepted, while "Hurr jackal" is not. Adjectives can disqualify a card unless it is a part of their name. "Giant ladybug" is a species name and therefore accepted, while "Venomous dragonfly" is not.

tags.label: swap removal
tags.description: Sorry I messed up your stuff. Here's a thing in exchange. (See also [humble](/tags/card/humble).)

tags.label: bombard-self
tags.description: Sacrifice this permanent to deal N damage. See also [fling-self](/tags/card/fling-self), [bombard](bombard).

tags.label: mana filter
tags.description: Convert mana to other colors.

tags.label: consult-cast
tags.description: Consult effects that let you cast the card you find.

tags.label: morbid
tags.description: Effects that care about at least one creature dying this turn.

tags.label: poisonous
tags.description: Makes, or is, a creature that poisons a player when it hits them.

tags.label: meme
tags.description: Cards that have become memes in Magic, or are explicitly based off of memes.

tags.label: single-minded color hate
tags.description: Cards that hate on a specific color (or colors), and do nothing else if that color isn't present.

tags.label: cheat death-self
tags.description: Cards that return themselves to the battlefield or to your hand at the moment they die.

tags.label: combat-neutral damage trigger
tags.description: Creature abilities that trigger upon dealing any amount of damage, no matter if it was done in combat or not. Compare and contrast [saboteur](saboteur).

tags.label: counter fuel-aesthetic
tags.description: These cards remove counters with no rules meaning as fuel.

tags.label: 40k model
tags.description: Cards named after and representing a Warhammer 40,000 model.

tags.label: mana producer
tags.description: Nonland cards that generate mana.

tags.label: deanimate self
tags.description: Creatures that can stop being creatures. For noncreatures that may become creatures, see [animate self](animate-self).

tags.label: energy generator
tags.description: Cards that in some way give you energy counters.

tags.label: ferocious
tags.description: Cards that care about you controlling creatures with power 4 or greater.

tags.label: your sacrifice matters
tags.description: Effects that reward you for sacrificing your own permanents. Contrast [opponent sacrifice matters](opponent-sacrifice-matters).

tags.label: mill-exile
tags.description: Exile cards from the top of a library.

tags.label: loot
tags.description: Draw a card, then discard a card. Mainly blue. See also [rummage](/tags/card/rummage), the red version, which discards then draws.

tags.label: exponential
tags.description: Effects that involve some amount of exponential growth. This can be an exponential value, or a token creation effect that would be exponential if allowed to progress unhindered. See [quadratic](quadratic) for a different, but similar kind of effect.

tags.label: mulch
tags.description: An effect that filters cards at the top of the library, putting remainders into the graveyard.

tags.label: undergrowth
tags.description: Cards that care about the number of creature cards in your graveyard.

tags.label: threshold
tags.description: Cards that care about you having seven or more cards in your graveyard.

tags.label: rummage
tags.description: Discard a card, then draw a card. Mainly red. See also [loot](/tags/card/loot), the blue version, which draws then discards.

tags.label: rainbow land
tags.description: A land that can net one or more mana of any color.

tags.label: cheat death
tags.description: Return a creature or permanent to the battlefield or to your hand at the moment it dies.

tags.label: tutored by name
tags.description: These cards are tutored by another specifically by their name. For the cards that tutor them, see [tutors by name](tutors-by-name).

tags.label: repeatable surveil
tags.description: See also: [repeatable scry](repeatable-scry).

tags.label: restricted blocker
tags.description: Cards that can block, but only in specific circumstances.

tags.label: long term impulsive draw
tags.description: Impulsive draw effects that let you play the exiled cards beyond this turn, letting you untap and have access to your full resources.

tags.label: gives castable from graveyard
tags.description: Allows you to play other cards from the graveyard.

tags.label: animate self
tags.description: Noncreatures that can become creatures. For creatures that can stop being creatures, see [deanimate self](deanimate-self).

tags.label: nightveil theft
tags.description: Cards that effectively "draw" from your opponent's library by exiling their cards and letting you play them.

tags.label: restricted attacker
tags.description: Cards that can only attack in specific circumstances.

tags.label: bombard
tags.description: Sacrifice something else to deal N damage. See also [fling](/tags/card/fling), [bombard-self](bombard-self).

tags.label: cost reducer
tags.description: Cards that make other spells cost less. (Does not apply to effects that reduce a spell's own cost, like delve.)

tags.label: exile on resolution

tags.description: Look at the top N cards of a library and rearrange them.

tags.description: A family of two-card rummage spells.

tags.description: When you deal me damage, I deal you damage right back.

tags.description: Cards from Planeswalker Decks that tutor for the corresponding planeswalker.

tags.description: Mana that can't be spent to cast nonartifact spells.

tags.description: Seek for nonland cards.

tags.description: Cards that tutor Swamp cards.

Return everything (or every
